[[:File:Tasca's Demise non-interactive map.jpg|Non-interactive map]] | ingame name=Tasca's Demise | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=092 }} [[Tasca's Demise]] is a small area in the Southern Shiverpeaks packed with [[Stone Summit]]. Most notably, as soon as you come out of [[Granite Citadel]] there is a set of three peaks. There are Stone Summit hiding behind all of them and will [[popup]] as soon as you approach. ==Foes== [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] ([[Stone Summit]]) *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Carver]] *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Summit Giant Herder]] *{{r}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Ranger]] *{{mo}} 24 (26) [[Dolyak Master]] *{{n}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Gnasher]] *{{me}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Heretic]] [[Elemental]]s (Stone Summit) * {{e}} 24 (26) [[Siege Ice Golem]] [[Tengu]] ([[Avicara]]s) *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Avicara Brave]] *{{r}} 24 (26) [[Avicara Fierce]] *{{n}} 24 (26) [[Avicara Guile]] *{{me}} 24 (26) [[Avicara Wise]] == Notes == * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.5% to the [[Tyrian Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 93|low = 78|high = 109}} ** While [[Defend Droknar's Forge]] is active, there will be more foes to vanquish. However, you will not get vanquishing credit for the Titans that [[spawn]] from other Titans, whom you must also kill. ** The [[Avicara]] near [[Mineral Springs]] are hostile to the [[Stone Summit]]. ** Watch out for [[patrol]]s before engaging the Stone Summit in the camp at the center of the zone. ** An [[Avicara]] near [[Mineral Springs]] may spawn behind portal requiring to rezone. {{bug|A [[Shiverpeak Chest]] (or [[Locked Chest]] in hard mode) may sometimes [[spawn]] behind the [[portal]] to [[Mineral Springs]].}} ==Trivia== *This area is named after [[Marshall Tasca]]. *This location has had its spawn patterns adjusted to increase the amount of enchantment removal due to intensive [[bot]] [[farm]]ing. *[[Cursed Lands]] (non-[[War in Kryta]] area), Tasca's Demise and [[Icedome]] are the only areas in Prophecies without a friendly NPC (aside of [[Nicholas the Traveler]]). [[Dreadnought's Drift]] is a similar case, but has one conditional temporary friendly NPC in the form of the [[Avatar of Dwayna (NPC)|Avatar of Dwayna]]. {{Explorable areas in the Southern Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Tascas Ableben]]
